review_scope: Bounded FC-089 candidate and necessary neighbouring distinctions; other established interpretations preserved.
research_method: Canonical occurrence source packet plus relevant joint searches in RESEARCH-LEDGER.json; inaccessible historical contracts remain unknown, not unperformed research.

access_limit: The incident-specific Claude Status page was not independently recovered as a stable page.
Reporter observations cover particular free and Pro accounts and do not establish universal message distribution.
The brief bulletin does not provide a complete recovery timestamp or technical root cause.
The 15:20 UTC update describes API recovery at 08:01 PT / 16:01 UTC. Its stated times and publication time conflict; precise API recovery ordering is not resolved.
The status log does not establish account-specific allowance messages or internal root cause.

occurrence_evidence.claim: Anthropic opened an elevated-error incident at 14:53 UTC and said a fix was being implemented at 15:03. It later reported continued web/platform downtime and failed Claude Code login.
During the outage, reporters could not log in on mobile. A Pro-account verification-code submission also failed. Exact relative timing of these account observations is not fixed by the provider log.

During the same provider-confirmed outage, TechRadar observed one unused free account incorrectly described as having exhausted its prompt allowance and shown a Pro upgrade suggestion. The misrepresented allowance state and paid-upgrade prompt were one user-facing episode.
Reporters later regained login but still received service-busy errors on prompts. A suggested model switch did not restore a response.

Anthropic separately reported API recovery and continued login problems. Its API-recovery update contains conflicting clock times. Login rates stabilised by the 16:29 update; the full incident was marked resolved at 17:42 UTC.

evidence_summary: Login and verification errors coincided with incorrect free-plan/upgrade presentation; model switching failed and API recovery preceded full recovery.
unestablished_fact_or_limit: Customer entitlement and independent continuity standard beyond incorrect plan display.

criterion_tests.literal: A bounded AI-mediated service or material function has an independently established availability, usable-quality or continuity requirement applicable to the responsible actor, affected users or dependent workflow and relevant time; state the actual basis and threshold rather than inferring obligation from harm or popularity.
criterion_tests.reason: The independently applicable duty and threshold are not established: Customer entitlement and independent continuity standard beyond incorrect plan display.

criterion_tests.literal: The service or function materially becomes unavailable, is withdrawn or restricted, or degrades in capability, latency, reliability, completeness, accessibility or another governed functional dimension, relative to the established applicable requirement.
criterion_tests.reason: Login and verification errors coincided with incorrect free-plan/upgrade presentation; model switching failed and API recovery preceded full recovery. The shortfall relative to a governed threshold cannot be determined without the missing obligation.

criterion_tests.literal: The requirement calls for a specified degree of maintained usable function, timely recovery, safe degraded mode, feasible fallback or proportionate planned-change/termination response under the evidenced operating conditions.
criterion_tests.reason: The required response for this service cannot be inferred from the observed disruption: Customer entitlement and independent continuity standard beyond incorrect plan display.

criterion_tests.literal: The actor's actual availability, recovery, degraded operation, fallback or transition materially fails that applicable requirement; identify the specific omitted or ineffective measure or the breached availability threshold and what evidence establishes it.
criterion_tests.reason: No finding that actual mitigation failed an applicable standard is possible solely from this sequence: Login and verification errors coincided with incorrect free-plan/upgrade presentation; model switching failed and API recovery preceded full recovery.

criterion_tests.literal: The shortfall materially impairs the governed service use or dependent function. A later resolution does not retroactively demonstrate that availability or required transition held at the original decision time.
criterion_tests.reason: Interference or distress is preserved, but impairment of specifically obligated use is not established: Login and verification errors coincided with incorrect free-plan/upgrade presentation; model switching failed and API recovery preceded full recovery.

criterion_tests.literal: An AI-mediated service or material function has an independently established applicable availability or continuity obligation that is actually engaged by a service disruption, degradation, capacity pressure, material change or continuity transition.
criterion_tests.reason: The occurrence may engage continuity, but its independent obligation is unestablished: Customer entitlement and independent continuity standard beyond incorrect plan display.

criterion_tests.literal: The actor maintains the required usable function or activates a timely, proportionate and authorised recovery, safe degraded-mode, practical alternative or planned-transition response appropriate to that obligation.
criterion_tests.reason: Adequacy of an authorised response must be compared with that obligation; the observed response is: Login and verification errors coincided with incorrect free-plan/upgrade presentation; model switching failed and API recovery preceded full recovery.

criterion_tests.literal: Observed service state, access and recovery evidence demonstrates that the required level of availability or usable continuity actually held, or that applicable and justified limits were handled through a sufficient response; publication of a nominal fallback alone is not enough.
criterion_tests.reason: No measured satisfaction of the required service level follows from the available endpoint or recovery report: Customer entitlement and independent continuity standard beyond incorrect plan display.

criterion_tests.literal: An outage, ordinary service variation, transient inconvenience, dissatisfaction or adverse outcome without an independently evidenced and applicable availability, usable-quality or continuity requirement.
criterion_tests.reason: This is an evidence-state exclusion, not proof that no duty existed. Customer entitlement and independent continuity standard beyond incorrect plan display.

criterion_tests.literal: One inaccurate or harmful AI output without evidence of a service-level availability or governed functional-degradation defect; assess applicable output or decision-integrity classes.
criterion_tests.reason: The candidate concerns service operation or withdrawal, rather than a single inaccurate output: Claude login and plan-state errors.

criterion_tests.literal: A lawful and proportionate safety, security, abuse-prevention, service-maintenance or other valid restriction that is consistent with the applicable service obligation and feasible alternative or transition measures.
criterion_tests.reason: The validity, proportionality and sufficient alternatives of the restriction/response must be evidenced separately; Customer entitlement and independent continuity standard beyond incorrect plan display.

criterion_tests.literal: A temporary incident with an effective and proportionate degraded or recovery route that satisfies the applicable requirement; an unavoidable disruption for which no relevant feasible response was required.
criterion_tests.reason: Recovery adequacy or absence of a feasible required response is not established merely by eventual resolution: Login and verification errors coincided with incorrect free-plan/upgrade presentation; model switching failed and API recovery preceded full recovery.

criterion_tests.literal: The only demonstrated error is an incorrect description of access or outage state while the functional service obligation remains satisfied; assess FC-032.
criterion_tests.reason: The candidate includes an actual function/access question, not only its description: Claude login and plan-state errors.

criterion_tests.literal: The only demonstrated defect is loss of otherwise-valid access because a dependent identity or licence verification cannot complete; assess FC-048 unless an independent broader service availability requirement also failed.
criterion_tests.reason: Verification may explain access but does not supply a broader obligation.

criterion_tests.literal: The only demonstrated defect is loss of durable work state or inaccurate restored work state while service-function availability requirements are otherwise satisfied; assess FC-035 or FC-036.
criterion_tests.reason: The candidate is not solely durable or restored work-state loss: Claude login and plan-state errors.

criterion_tests.literal: The only demonstrated defect is infrastructure access coercion or compelled governance concessions; assess FC-058 or FC-059 as appropriate.
criterion_tests.reason: No claim that an infrastructure concession was demanded is the basis of this availability candidate: Claude login and plan-state errors.

criterion_tests.literal: The only demonstrated defect is failure to provide an interaction-level protection response to evidenced vulnerability; assess FC-087, allowing co-occurrence only for a separately evidenced service-level continuity failure.
criterion_tests.reason: The proposed property concerns service function rather than only an interaction-level vulnerability response: Claude login and plan-state errors.

neighbour_comparison: FC-032 and FC-048 distinguish state/verification defects. FC-089 needs the additional service obligation.
